run_prepare_competition: run the prepare script with --competition-id to download and prepare a single Kaggle competition dataset
run_prepare_split: run the prepare script with --split to prepare multiple competitions listed in a split file
run_prepare_keep_raw: run the prepare script with --keep-raw to retain raw competition files after preparation
run_prepare_skip_verification: run the prepare script with --skip-verification to skip checksum verification during dataset preparation
run_prepare_custom_data_dir: run the prepare script with --data-dir to store prepared competition data in a custom directory
